label: THE GAMESTOP SAGA
voice_script: In 2021, Wall Street giants were sure GameStop was dead. They bet billions on its failure, shorting over 140% of the company's entire stock—a seemingly impossible number. But they overlooked a small army of investors on a Reddit forum called WallStreetBets. They saw the hedge funds' over-exposed position and attacked, buying shares and driving the price from seventeen dollars to over four hundred. It was a historic squeeze, pushing the giants towards bankruptcy. Then, right at the peak, the popular trading app Robinhood suddenly banned users from buying the stock. They said it was to protect investors. But to millions, it looked like the system was rigging the game to save its own.
